book.name: XHUN
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ CHUSBꞌALTETZ U JESUUS ITZꞌIBꞌA U XHAN Unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Xhun tiꞌ u Jesús

content: Nibꞌaꞌnxisa u Jesús umaꞌl u tzot
As tul nikat ixaan u Jesús tu bꞌey, as til veꞌt Aak umaꞌl u naj uvaꞌ tzotike stitzꞌebꞌeꞌ.
As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa ichusulibꞌ Aak ileꞌ: —¿Chusul, abꞌil etz u paaveꞌ tiꞌ uveꞌ tzot vas najeꞌ stitzꞌebꞌeꞌ? ¿Ma ipaav naj? ¿Pet moj ipaav u txutx bꞌaalaeꞌ?— tiꞌk chajnaj.

Ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —Yeꞌle. Jit ipaav najeꞌ. As jit ipaav vitxutx najeꞌ tukꞌ vibꞌaal najeꞌ uvaꞌ tzotik naj stitzꞌebꞌeꞌ, pet aqꞌal uvaꞌ la ikꞌuch u Tiixheꞌ vibꞌaꞌnileꞌ tiꞌ naj. As estiꞌeꞌ tzotik naj stitzꞌebꞌeꞌ.
As techal chit tuk unbꞌan unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ tal tzan u chajol vetzeꞌ sve tul uvaꞌ yeꞌxnaj bꞌen qꞌii, tan tul la ok aqꞌbꞌal, as yeꞌxhebꞌil la uch veꞌt taqꞌonveꞌ.
As tul atiltel in vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, as in txijun tetz u taanxelal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ,— tiꞌk Aak.
As tzubꞌik veꞌt kuꞌ Aak tu txꞌavaꞌ. Ibꞌan veꞌt Aak unbꞌiil u suj. As toksa veꞌt ok Aak u sujeꞌ tziꞌ ivatz u tzoteꞌ.

As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ te u tzoteꞌ: —Kuxh txꞌaa vavatzeꞌ tu u piilaeꞌ uveꞌ Siloé,— tiꞌk Aak. As isuuchil u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ Siloé, uveꞌ «chajel tzan.» As oora chit bꞌex itxꞌaa veꞌt u tzoteꞌ vivatzeꞌ tu u aꞌeꞌ. As tul qꞌaav veꞌt naj, as nik tilon veꞌt naj.

As unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ echen kꞌatz ikabꞌal naj tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ ootzinik tetz naj uvaꞌ tzotik naj, as ech tal veꞌt ileꞌ: —¿Ma jit u najeꞌ uveꞌ nikat ixonebꞌ tiꞌ ijoyat ipuaj?— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
As at uxhchil nik alon: —Kano. Najeꞌ taꞌ,— tiꞌke. As at jolte uvaꞌ: —Yeꞌle. Jit najeꞌ. As eela unbꞌiil tilon naj tukꞌ u tzoteꞌ,— tiꞌke. As ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ: —Ineꞌ uvaꞌ inik tzot,— tiꞌk naj.
As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchil ileꞌ te naj: —¿Kam qꞌi uveꞌ neelon veꞌt cheel?— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.

Ech tal veꞌt u naj ileꞌ uvaꞌ tzotike: —U najeꞌ uvaꞌ Jesús ibꞌii as kat ibꞌan unbꞌiil u suj. As kat toksa ok tziꞌ unvatz. As ech tal ileꞌ sve, «Kuxh txꞌaa vavatzeꞌ tu u aꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ Siloé,» tiꞌk sve. As kat bꞌex untxꞌaa veꞌt vunvatzeꞌ. As yak kuxh ilon veꞌt in,— tiꞌk u najeꞌ uvaꞌ tzotike.
As ech tal unqꞌa uxhchil ileꞌ te naj: —¿Kat atkat u najeꞌ qꞌi?— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ. Ech tal veꞌt u naj ileꞌ uvaꞌ tzotike: —Yeꞌ vootzaj,— tiꞌk naj.
Nichꞌoti unqꞌa fariseo itziꞌ u naj uvaꞌ tzotike
U naj uvaꞌ tzotike as eqꞌol veꞌt ok naj vatz unqꞌa fariseo,
tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ tu u xeem qꞌiieꞌ uveꞌ ibꞌan u Jesús u sujeꞌ. As ibꞌaꞌnxisa veꞌt Aak vivatz u najeꞌ.

As ichꞌoti veꞌt unqꞌa fariseo te u najeꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ kam kat ibꞌan naj tiꞌ uvaꞌ ni tilon veꞌt naj. As ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ: —Suj kuxheꞌ kat toksa tziꞌ unvatz. As tul kat bꞌex untxꞌaa vunvatzeꞌ, as kat ilon veꞌt in,— tiꞌk naj.

As ech tal veꞌt kaꞌl unqꞌa fariseo ileꞌ: —¡Junkꞌu! Tan aꞌ texhlal tetz uvaꞌ jit xeꞌ u Tiixheꞌ tzaanajkat u najeꞌ, tan nipaasa naj tzii tu u xeem qꞌiieꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj. Pet ech koj kaꞌt chajnaj: —Asoj aapaav u najeꞌ, as ¿kam la tulbꞌe naj qꞌi ikꞌuchat umaj kꞌuchbꞌal tetz tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ echeꞌ u veeꞌ?— tiꞌk chajnaj. As nik tok veꞌt ixoꞌl chajnaj svatzaj tiꞌ u Jesús.

As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ te u najeꞌ uveꞌ tzotike: —¿Kano axh qꞌi? ¿Kam ni tal aama tiꞌ u najeꞌ uveꞌ kat bꞌaꞌnxisan vavatzeꞌ?— tiꞌk chajnaj. As ech tal veꞌt u naj ileꞌ: —Ni valeꞌ uvaꞌ qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ u najeꞌ,— tiꞌk naj.
Pet ech koj unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ nik ichꞌoꞌn taama tiꞌ u Jesús, tan yeꞌ nik inima uvaꞌ tzotik u najeꞌ, as nik tilon veꞌt naj. As bꞌex mololoj veꞌt vitxutx najeꞌ tukꞌ vibꞌaal najeꞌ.

As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ te vitxutx najeꞌ tukꞌ vibꞌaal najeꞌ: —¿Ma aꞌ vakꞌaoleꞌ u vaaꞌ tzotike stitzꞌebꞌeꞌ uveꞌ ni tal unqꞌa tenameꞌ? ¿As kam kat ibꞌan naj uvaꞌ ni tilon veꞌt naj cheel?— tiꞌk chajnaj.
Ech tal veꞌt vitxutx naj ileꞌ tukꞌ vibꞌaal najeꞌ: —Taꞌn qootzajle uvaꞌ qetz naj, as tzotik naj stitzꞌebꞌeꞌ.
Pet yeꞌ qootzaj kam kat ibꞌan naj uvaꞌ ni tilon veꞌt naj, as abꞌil kat bꞌaꞌnxisan vivatz najeꞌ. Pet echꞌotitaj te naj. As an kuxh najeꞌ tuk alon sete, tan tzꞌajnajlu veꞌt iyaabꞌ naj,— tiꞌk chaꞌma.

Tan nikat ixoꞌv veꞌt chaꞌma te unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa tenameꞌ, tan maꞌtik ikꞌulat tibꞌ iyol chajnaj uvaꞌ asoj abꞌil la niman uvaꞌ aꞌ u Cristo u Jesús, as la laqꞌbꞌal el tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh, uveꞌ nikat tal chajnaj.
Estiꞌeꞌ tal vitxutx u najeꞌ tukꞌ vibꞌaal najeꞌ uvaꞌ: —Echꞌotitaj te naj, tan tzꞌajnajlu veꞌt iyaabꞌ naj,— tiꞌk chaꞌma.

As molol veꞌt u najeꞌ uveꞌ tzotike. As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa tenam ileꞌ te naj: —Yeꞌ eesa iqꞌii u Tiixheꞌ tukꞌ u chuli yoleꞌ, tan ileꞌ ootzimal sqaꞌn uvaꞌ aapaaveꞌ u najeꞌ uveꞌ kat bꞌaꞌnxisan vavatzeꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ: —Yeꞌ vootzaj bꞌa asoj aapaav u najeꞌ moj yeꞌle. Pet taꞌn kuxh ootzimaleꞌ svaꞌn uvaꞌ inik tzot, as cheel il in ni vilon veꞌteꞌ,— tiꞌk naj.
As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ: —¿Kam qꞌi kat tulbꞌe axh naj tiꞌ ibꞌaꞌnxisal vavatzeꞌ?— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As ech tal veꞌt u naj ileꞌ: —As valleꞌ sete. As yeꞌ kuxh ni tok vunyoleꞌ teviꞌ. ¿As kam qꞌi uvaꞌ nesaꞌ etabꞌit unpajte? ¿Ma aꞌ nesaꞌ bꞌa uvaꞌ antu veꞌt ex la ok ex sichusulibꞌ u najeꞌ?— tiꞌk naj.
As yoqꞌon veꞌt chajnaj te u najeꞌ. Ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ: —¡Echen nooksakat eebꞌ kꞌatz naj! ¡Pet ech koj oꞌ, tan aꞌ ni qoksakat qibꞌ kꞌatz u Moisés!
As ootzimal sqaꞌn uvaꞌ kat yolon u Tiixheꞌ tukꞌ u Moisés, pet ech koj u najeꞌ tan yeꞌ qootzaj katil tzaanajkat naj,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ te chajnaj: —¡Vaꞌlen kuxh eyoloneꞌ! Yeꞌ etootzale katil tzaanajlukat Aak, as tul Aak kat bꞌaꞌnxisan vunvatzeꞌ.
As ootzimal svaꞌn setukꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ ni tabꞌi u Tiixheꞌ viyol unqꞌa aapaaveꞌ. Pet abꞌil uvaꞌ ni niman Aak as nibꞌaneꞌ kam uvaꞌ ni tal Aak, as aꞌ uxhchileꞌ ni tabꞌi u Tiixheꞌ viyoleꞌ.
Pet yeꞌ atixoj vabꞌi uvaꞌ at umaj uxhchil la ilon umaj tzot staꞌn uvaꞌ tzotik stitzꞌebꞌeꞌ.
Asoj jit kꞌatz u Tiixheꞌ tzaanajkat, as yeꞌxhkam chiteꞌ la itxꞌol ibꞌanataꞌ,— tiꞌk naj.

As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa tenam ileꞌ: —¡Axh chit umaꞌl u aapaav tul kat itzꞌebꞌ axh! ¿As la kol achusoꞌk tzan oꞌ qꞌa uvaꞌ naaleꞌ?— tiꞌk chajnaj. As ilaqꞌbꞌa veꞌt el chajnaj vas najeꞌ tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh.
Ech unqꞌa fariseo echeꞌ umaj tzot tukꞌ vitxumbꞌaleꞌ
As tul tabꞌi veꞌt u Jesús uvaꞌ maꞌtik ilaqꞌbꞌal el tzan u najeꞌ, as ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ te naj tul ilej Aak naj: —¿Ma kꞌujleꞌl akꞌuꞌl tiꞌ viKꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ?— tiꞌk Aak.
As ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ: —¿As abꞌiste viKꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ qꞌi, tiꞌ uvaꞌ la unkꞌujbꞌaꞌ unkꞌuꞌl stiꞌ?— tiꞌk naj.
As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —As ootzimal veꞌteꞌ aꞌn, tan ineꞌ uveꞌ nunyolon see,— tiꞌk Aak.
Ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ: —¡Tuk unkꞌujbꞌaꞌ veꞌt unkꞌuꞌl seeꞌ!— tiꞌk naj. As kuꞌ veꞌt naj qaaloj vatz Aak.

As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —Estiꞌeꞌ kat ul in vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ tiꞌ ul unjatxat ixoꞌl unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, tan la ilon veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ ni tiloneꞌ. Pet ech koj unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ ni tiloneꞌ ni taleꞌ, as aꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ tzot veꞌteꞌ,— tiꞌk Aak.
As tul tabꞌi veꞌt kaꞌl unqꞌa fariseo, as ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ: —¿As ma oꞌ tzot bꞌa uveꞌ naaleꞌ?— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Ex koj tzot, as yeꞌl epaaveꞌ ati. Pet tiꞌ uvaꞌ netaleꞌ uvaꞌ, «Ni qiloneꞌ,» chꞌex netaleꞌ, as estiꞌeꞌ uveꞌ eqꞌomal vepaaveꞌ setaꞌn,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
